links.outcome: Self-reported AI knowledge, familiarity, prior exposure, and demand for AI training among midwifery students
links.effect: Familiarity with advanced AI techniques scored 1.20 (95% CI 1.13-1.27); prior exposure 1.36; institutional support 1.43; belief that students and professionals should be trained in AI 4.11 (95% CI 4.02-4.20).
links.quote: Self-reported AI knowledge and familiarity were below the scale midpoint, with the lowest score observed for familiarity with advanced AI techniques (1.20, 95% CI 1.13-1.27).

unlisted_practices: Integrating AI literacy into health professional (midwifery) pre-service curricula, distinguishing general, generative, and regulated clinical AI

screen.reason: The study is a national survey and qualitative interview study assessing AI literacy, perceptions, perceived risks, and training needs among French midwifery students.
